messages.subject: Okafor — settlement advice and Board authority
messages.plaintextBody:
Daniel,

Attached is our written advice on merits and settlement, consistent with Harriet's view. In short: ~60–65% prospects of defeating the whistleblowing claims at a final hearing, but a severe downside (an uncapped award realistically £180k–£210k plus c.£100k of irrecoverable costs and the reputational/CQC exposure of an adverse finding).

We recommend you seek Board authority to settle up to £120,000 gross, with the first £30,000 tax-free, an agreed reference, mutual confidentiality and non-derogatory terms, and a small contribution to the Claimant's legal costs. Our opening offer of £95,000 went out on 28 April; Birchall Stone have countered at £165,000.

Happy to attend the Board on 9 May.

Sarah
